verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f1="components/spaces/email/composer-shell.tsx",f2="app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/collaborators/venue-holds-panel.tsx",f3="lib/spaces/campaigns.ts";for(const f of [f1,f2,f3]){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error("SCAN-702: missing "+f);process.exit(79)}}const c=fs.readFileSync(f1,"utf8"),v=fs.readFileSync(f2,"utf8"),s=fs.readFileSync(f3,"utf8");const rawSched=/scheduleSpaceCampaign\([^)]*,\s*when\s*,/.test(c);const rawHold=/requestVenueHold\([^)]*\{[^}]*\bstartsAt\s*,\s*endsAt\b[^}]*\}/.test(v);const fn=s.slice(s.indexOf("function parseScheduleTime"));const body=fn.slice(0,fn.indexOf("\n}")+2);const zoneGate=/\[\+\-\]|\(Z\|/.test(body);if(rawSched||rawHold||!zoneGate){console.error("SCAN-702: a zone-less datetime-local wall time still reaches the server unchanged (composer raw="+rawSched+", venue hold raw="+rawHold+", parseScheduleTime zone gate="+zoneGate+"), so a scheduled campaign or venue hold is stored as UTC and goes out hours off from the time the owner chose.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The campaign composer and the venue-holds panel sent the raw datetime-local value (a local wall time with no zone) to the server, where new Date(raw) read it as UTC, so a 2:30 PM Los Angeles schedule was stored as 14:30Z and went out at 7:30 AM; the campaign list then formatted scheduled_for in the server zone so the owner could not see it. Fixed on both halves: a new pure lib/time/instant.ts gives the client localInputToIso (composer-shell.tsx and venue-holds-panel.tsx now send a Z instant) and the server parseZonedInstant; parseScheduleTime (lib/spaces/campaigns.ts) and venue-actions toIso refuse any string with no Z or offset suffix, so an unconverted wall time can never reach a row again. The campaign list renders times through a LocalWhen client leaf (useSyncExternalStore: UTC labelled on the server, the viewer zone on the client). The journeys launch editor already converted on the client and is unchanged. Pinned by lib/time/instant.test.ts, the zone-less case in lib/spaces/campaigns.test.ts, and components/spaces/email/local-when.test.tsx.
